gloss: on all fours; crawling on hands and knees

definitions.gloss: on all fours; crawling position; hands and knees
definitions.explanation: The posture of being down on both hands and both knees, like a crawling baby or an animal. Used to describe the physical position itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{四|よ}つん{這|ば}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The baby is crawling on all fours.

examples.japanese: {四|よ}つん{這|ば}いになって、⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I got on all fours and looked under the bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}くて→低い：02947_hikui⟧、{四|よ}つん{這|ば}いでしか⟦{進|すす}めなかった→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The ceiling inside the dark tunnel was so low that we could only move forward on all fours.

notes:
{四|よ}つん{這|ば}い describes the posture of being on all fours — both hands and both knees on the ground. Comes from {四|よ}つ (four) + {這|は}い (crawling).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {四|よ}つん{這|ば}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get on all fours
- {四|よ}つん{這|ば}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to move forward on all fours
- {四|よ}つん{這|ば}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: all-fours posture
- {四|よ}つん{這|ば}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to search on all fours

USAGE:
Describes a physical posture, not a movement verb. Typically used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to assume the position) or で (while in the position). Common contexts include babies crawling, searching under furniture, or moving through low spaces.
